CustomField.description: Derived, never written directly. True only when the current owner of this Offering is a queue (Group) rather than a user. Offering__c has no record types, so unlike the Lead precedent (Is_Owner_Investor_Onboarding_Queue__c) no second condition is needed to scope this further. Drives Dynamic Actions visibility on the Offering record page (queue-owned "assign to me" action vs. user-owned "pre launch" action). No queue currently supports Offering__c as an ownable object, so this evaluates false on every real record today - that is expected, not a bug. Not placed on any layout.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: System field. True when this Offering is currently owned by a queue rather than a user.
CustomField.label: Is Owner Queue?
